description: Confirmed incident cases for offline KaiMS RCA and resolution evaluation.

alert.name: ReplicationStopped
alert.description: Replica IO thread stopped with MySQL error 1227: access denied; missing REPLICATION CLIENT privilege.

evidence.text: ERROR 1227 Access denied; you need REPLICATION CLIENT privilege
Replication account grants changed 4 minutes before alert

cases.confirmed_root_cause: The replication account lost its required REPLICATION CLIENT privilege.
acceptable_actions: reapply the approved replication account grants

operator_feedback.notes: Grant restoration resumed replication without restart.

alert.name: HighLatencyP99
alert.description: P99 latency rose above 4 seconds after database connections saturated.

evidence.text: 84% of request duration spent awaiting SQL connection checkout

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Database connection-pool saturation caused requests to wait for connection checkout.
acceptable_actions: increase pool capacity after database capacity validation

operator_feedback.notes: Fixed an unclosed session and added bounded concurrency.

alert.name: CheckoutErrorRate
alert.description: Checkout HTTP 500 rate increased immediately after release 2026.08.07.3.

evidence.text: NullPointerException in CurrencyMapper introduced by release commit

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Release 2026.08.07.3 introduced a null-handling regression in CurrencyMapper.

operator_feedback.notes: Rollback restored baseline in six minutes.
Correct behavior is abstention and evidence collection.
